description: Two oranges and a bunch of green grapes sit on a flat, white surface against a dark blue background. One orange is partially peeled, revealing a pale yellow fruit. Both oranges sit on the left side of the image, while the grapes rest on the right. The entire composition is rendered in a loose, slightly abstract style with little detail.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
